data.text: The clock provided the punctuation marks for group activity, while enabling individuals to order their own work (and that of others) so as to enhance productivity.

主语 The clock + 谓语 provided + 宾语 the punctuation marks + 定语 for group activity + 状语 while enabling individuals to order their own work (and that of others) so as to enhance productivity.

### 【主谓一致】
主语 The clock 单数，谓语 provided 单数过去式。

### 【动词时态与原形】
主句一般过去时；while enabling 为现在分词作状语；to order, to enhance 为不定式。

### 【修饰语分析】
- 'for group activity'：介词短语作后置定语，修饰 punctuation marks。
